## Appearance

Cedric possesses features of delicate refinement and large, dark blue eyes. Though noted as quite tiny for his years as a child when he wore a halo of chestnut brown curls, he grew to be tall for his age by thirteen. By age sixteen, he sports short-cut brown hair rather than his former curls.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v3 ch.People P6](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)_

## Personality

Cedric Stanhope is an intelligent and exceptionally unusual child who possesses a brilliant mind and great manliness, capable of holding his own in games. Described as a clean, complete gentleman, he also displays an imaginative nature, once imagining the evening star as a fairy lighthouse. His primary desire is to have a mother.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P10](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0010), +1 more_

## History

After moving from the States to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), Cedric Stanhope resided with his grandmother near the beach. On her first day teaching in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) formed an immediate warm connection with Cedric, who became her favorite student and later gifted her wild orchids on her walk home. Lacking companions, Cedric detailed his whimsical imaginary friends in a letter and later walked to the cemetery with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), opening up about his late mother, father, and life with his grandmother. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) later visited Cedric at his house, where they shared tea after discussing his thoughts and worries, and she later accompanied him on a visit to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) where he sat with [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) as she confided in him about her imaginary dream-boy. Following the end of the school term, Cedric's father, [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md), unexpectedly arrived at his home, prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to deliver a message to [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) on Stephen's behalf.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P11](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0011), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), +27 more_

## Quotes

> "Mrs. Sowerby, father made a pretty good job of picking out my first mother and I could trust him to pick out just as good a one the second time."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022)

> "you can’t imagine what took place! Something truly wonderful. Father has arrived . . . only imagine that! Father has arrived! Step right inside. Father, this is my lovely teacher. You understand, father."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

> "and I returned so I could offer them to you since I believed you were a lady who would appreciate them, and also because . . ."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> "Mary Joe, do you know what I think? I think the evening star is a lighthouse on the land where the fairies dwell."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028)

> "He understands that I will refuse to be seen with him unless he complies. I believe he is truly steeped in evil."
>
> — Cedric Stanhope — [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P14](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0014)

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--nell-harcourt.md)

[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) is Cedric's former schoolteacher and close friend, with whom he shares a strong mutual affection and understanding. The two frequently take walks together, visit local acquaintances, and share deep conversations about Cedric's late mother, his family, and his worries. Their bond goes beyond the classroom, as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) remains a trusted confidante whom Cedric visits at home.

### [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--harcourt.md)

[Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) served as Cedric's teacher in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).
